I just got my car washed. It took an hour and a half, and when I politely told the chubby blond guy (probably the manager) that they should let you know how long it takes, he answered rudely, saying they only have one employee and that's how long it takes them. I told him again that they should let you know so you can decide, and he argued with me again and answered rudely. I didn't pursue it further so it wouldn't escalate.
